paragraphs.text: The next morning, Mia puts the message in her school bag. She and Sam run to the bus stop. Ben is there, but the bus is late. They wait.
‘What if we are late?’ Mia asks. ‘The message is for Anna.’ Sam takes her hand. At last, the bus comes. The children get on. The bus moves very slowly. Ben points to the clock. Mia looks at it.
They reach school as the bell rings. They run to the classroom. Their teacher is there. Mia gives her the message. ‘Thank you,’ the teacher says. ‘I can call Anna’s family today.’
